issues.description: Reports mix poor audio quality with excessive advertising, high data use, and unrelated complaints, so the examples do not describe one consistent problem.
Most examples report a false offline status despite working internet, while a few describe general loading, startup, or regional access failures.
Reviews mainly report instability, crashes, lag, or slow startup when using the app.
Examples combine playback failures and interruptions with complaints about mobile playback restrictions and being directed to unwanted songs.
issues.issue_name: Songs fail to play as expected

issues.description: Reviews mix unwanted suggested-song playback with interruptions, update-related bugs, and other playback complaints.
